name: PIN input
description: One box per character for verification codes, two-factor authentication tokens and passcodes. Typing advances to the next box, Backspace steps back, and pasting or SMS autofill fills the whole code at once.

classes.ayy-pin-input: Root group (role="group", direction ltr so codes always read left to right).
classes.ayy-pin-input__group: Tighter cluster of slots when a code is split into halves (e.g. 3 + 3).

default.looks: Square wash boxes with 1px line-strong borders, centred monospace digits.

pressed.none: Text slots have no pressed look; clicking focuses and selects the slot.

focus.looks: 2px --ayy-color-ring outline (-1px offset); the slot border goes transparent.

error.looks: 60% destructive border and destructive focus ring. Forced colours: dashed border.

loading.none: Disable the slots and show a Spinner on the verify Button while checking the code.

scale.sm: Square at --ayy-size-control-sm (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), sm text.
scale.md: Square at --ayy-size-control-md (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch), field text.
scale.lg: Square at --ayy-size-control-lg (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), lg text.

sizes.density: Slot width, height and text size follow data-density across all steps.

js: pinInputClass({ size?, className? }) → string; pinInputGroupClass, pinInputSeparatorClass, pinInputSlotClass constants; connectPinInput(root, { type?, onChange?, onComplete? }) → { value, setValue, clear, focus, destroy }.

element.description: Wires an .ayy-pin-input of .ayy-pin-input__slot inputs: auto-advance, Backspace, arrows, paste, SMS autofill, optional hidden form input, and change/complete events.
element.children: An .ayy-pin-input containing .ayy-pin-input__slot <input> elements (optionally grouped in .ayy-pin-input__group with .ayy-pin-input__separator).

attributes.name: Form field name: syncs a hidden input with the combined code.

events.ayy-change: { value: string } — fired whenever the code changes.
events.ayy-complete: { value: string } — fired once every slot is filled.

props.length: number — total slots when groups is omitted (default 6).
props.groups: number[] — split slots into groups with a dash between them, e.g. [3, 3].
props.mask: boolean — hide entered characters as password dots.
props.onComplete: (value: string) => void — called once all slots are filled.
props.invalid: boolean — sets aria-invalid="true" on the group and slots.
props.name: string — renders a hidden input carrying the combined code.
props.autoFocus: boolean — focuses the first slot on mount.
props.placeholder: string — placeholder character per empty slot.
props.slotLabel: (index: number, total: number) => string — accessible label per slot.
props....rest: All native <div> attributes on the group.

a11y: Wrap in a Field with a Label (or aria-labelledby on the group), and keep each slot's aria-label ("Digit 1 of 6").
The first slot carries autocomplete="one-time-code" so SMS and password-manager autofill populate the whole code.
Digits always read left to right even in RTL layouts; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move visually between slots.
do: Use a PIN input for fixed-length verification codes, authenticator tokens, backup codes and numeric PINs.
Group 6- or 8-character codes as [3, 3] or [4, 4] so people can scan and compare them at a glance.
Accept pasted codes containing spaces or dashes — connectPinInput strips them automatically.
dont: Don't use a PIN input for variable-length passwords or API keys — use Input.
Don't auto-submit destructive actions on completion without a way to review or cancel.
